name: flex_color_scheme
summary: Third-party Flutter theming package for building Material-based light and dark ThemeData with seeded color schemes, surface blending, component configuration, and predefined theme schemes.
advantages: Builds coordinated light and dark ThemeData with extensive Material color and component configuration
Provides seed-based schemes, surface blending, predefined schemes, and higher-level theming controls
Can reduce repetitive manual ThemeData configuration for applications with substantial Material theming requirements
tradeoffs: Introduces a third-party theming abstraction on top of Flutter's built-in ThemeData and ColorScheme
Version 9.0.0 is a new major release and requires the newer Flutter/material_ui ecosystem; compatibility must be checked against the project's Flutter version
Projects with simple themes may not need the additional abstraction
recommendedFor: Material applications with extensive light/dark theme customization
Projects that want higher-level ColorScheme and component-theme configuration than raw ThemeData alone

verification.reason: Version 9.0.0 is a newly published major release with Flutter 3.47+/material_ui changes, so version-sensitive details should receive an additional documentation check before being treated as long-lived guidance.
